g.text: app-media-server - Playback Session and HLS VOD
RecordingSegment -> PlaybackEntry uses the intersection of
the requested time range and the closed MP4 segment range.
Recording gaps remain gaps in the absolute CCTV timeline.
filesrc -> qtdemux -> queue -> h264parse -> mpegtsmux -> filesink
The converter applies a KEY_UNIT seek and remuxes H264 MP4
into MPEG-TS without decode/re-encode. The actual start may
precede the requested offset by a keyframe boundary.
Writes a VOD index.m3u8 with EXTINF and
EXT-X-PROGRAM-DATE-TIME entries for CCTV wall-clock mapping.
